text: ためしに…　クチバシティに　ある　きでも　きって　みたまえ

structure.jp: クチバシティに　ある　きでも
structure.en: a tree in Vermilion City or something

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means 'try doing it and see what happens'. きって みたまえ = 'try cutting it'.

patterns.name: 〜たまえ
patterns.explanation: たまえ on a verb stem is a command used by a man of higher standing to someone below him, firm but not rude. みたまえ = 'do try it'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing offers it as just one loose example, like 'or something'. きでも = 'a tree or something'.
